public.accuracy_method: Own deterministic fact-level partial-credit scorer (ogr.r2.score): status must match (not_in_corpus only if predicted not_in_corpus with no answer); gold answers are flattened to atomic facts (normalised strings, numbers, list items, dict values; prose answers reduced to numbers, capitalised names and yes/no polarity); score = F1 against facts found in a structured prediction, or recall of facts present as whole-word matches in a free-text prediction; mean over questions.
